verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://docs.openclaw.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary, and a second llms.txt exists at openclaw.ai. The documentation pages are served as raw Markdown (.md URLs such as getting-started.md and tools/mcp.md), so they can be fed directly to an agent; the 404 only affected a doubled .md.md suffix. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs.
